name: TUM RGB-D Benchmark: RGB-D SLAM and Odometry Dataset
description: The TUM RGB-D Benchmark is an established visual SLAM and odometry dataset curated by the Computer Vision Group at the Technical University of Munich. Recorded using Microsoft Kinect sensors and an automated motion capture system, it provides 39 indoor sequences totaling 84,000 synchronized RGB and depth frames with sub-millimeter accurate 6-DoF ground truth trajectories, benchmarked for camera localization, odometry drift, and 3D surface reconstruction.
